newsitem.title: CANADA: London Insurance to support higher bid.
newsitem.headline: London Insurance to support higher bid.

text.p: London Insurance Group Inc said on Tuesday its board will recommend shareholders accept a richer offer from Great-West Lifeco Inc if Royal Bank of Canada does not match Great-West's rival bid.
Great-West surprised the Canadian stock market earlier on Tuesday with a C$2.9 billion bid for London Insurance, topping a C$2.4 billion offer from Royal Bank of Canada.
Under that offer, Royal Bank has until Friday, August 22 to respond to a competing bid.

"Subject to reviewing the detailed terms of the Great-West offer, and if there are no other material developments, the board intends to recommend that shareholders accept the Great-West offer," London Insurance said in a statement.
London Insurance said its board of directors determined that the Great-West offer is "more favorable" to shareholders from a financial point of view.
Under a lock-up agreement with the Royal Bank, London Insurance and Trilon Financial Corp would be required to support the bank's bid if it matched the Great-West offer.
Trilon Financial said earlier on Tuesday it also would tender its 57-percent stake in London Insurance to the Great-West bid if Royal Bank did not match the offer.
